sentences.text:
Herein, Petitioners and Respondent No. 01 submit as under:
1. The Respondent No. 01 is the defacto complainant in C.C. 2886/2024 pending against the Petitioners herein for the offences punishable u/s 498(A), NC:
2026:KHC-D:3157 HC-KAR 417, 504 and 34 of I.P.C. pending before the JMFC II Court, Belagavi.
2. Now with the interference of the elders of the respective families, the Petitioners and the Respondent No. 01 have amicably settled their disputes and wish to put an end to all litigations amongst them as under:
3. The Petitioners and Respondent No. 01 have agreed that the Petitioners would pay an amount of Rs.
14,00,000/- (Rupees Fourteen Lakhs Only) as final settlement payable to the Respondent No. 01.

This amount is in exclusion of Rs. 2,25,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh Twenty Five Thousand only)
already paid by the Petitioners to the Respondent No. 01)
4.

The Petitioners have paid an amount of Rs. 7,00,000/-(Rupees Seven Lakhs) to the Respondent No. 01 today, vide a Demand Draft bearing No. 183585 drawn on State Bank Of India Belagavi bank in favour of the Respondent No. 01 for Rs. 6,00,000/- (Rupees Six Lakhs) and by cash Rs.
1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only).

entities.text: State Bank Of India Belagavi bank
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
5. The Petitioner and the Respondent No. 01 agree that they would mutually file a petition for mutual divorce before the concerned Family Court on 09-03-2026 and the Petitioners and the Respondent No. 01 agree that the remaining payment of Rs. 7,00,000/- (Rupees Seven Lakhs)
would be made at the time of the decree of divorce is passed by the concerned jurisdictional Family Court.
6.

In view of this arrangement and settlement, the Respondent No. 01 agrees that she shall withdraw the NC: 2026:KHC-D:3157 HC-KAR petition filed by her before the Family Court, Belagavi for maintenance in Crl. Misc.229/2024 and would not claim any balance amount or any additional amount in this case or any other case and withdraw any other cases if initiated.
7.

The Respondent No. 01 also agrees that she will not file any additional petitions for seeking any sort of maintenance or any other monetary claim or any other claim on the property or any other belonging of the Petitioners.

8. In view of this settlement, the Petitioners and the Respondent No. 01 hereby agree that they would not lay any claim, past or future against each other including gold and other ornaments and this settlement and payment shall be full and final.

10. In the event of the Petitioners breaching the terms of this agreement/memo, the Responderit is at liberty to revive the proceedings in C.C. 2886/2024 and any other pending proceedings.
the Respondent is at liberty to initiate appropriate action before the Courts of law.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:3157 HC-KAR

On the above mentioned terms and conditions, the Petitioners and the Respondent No. 01 pray that the proceedings in C.C. 2886/2024 pending before the JMFC, II Court, Belagavi for the offences punishable u/s 498(A), 417, 504 and 34 of 1.P.C. be quashed against the Petitioners herein in the interest of justice and equity."
4.

On enquiry, the parties agree that the contents of the joint memo correctly depict the true terms of settlement and that the compromise has been arrived at voluntarily, without any force, undue influence, or coercion.

5. Accordingly, the following order is passed:
ORDER i.Placing the joint memo on record, the petition stands allowed.
ii.
The pending criminal proceedings in CC No.2886/2024 (arising out of Crime No.15/2024) pending on the file of the JMFC-II Court, Belagavi, are hereby quashed.
iii.A sum of Rs.7,00,000/- has been tendered by the petitioners to the respondent No.1, comprising NC: 2026:KHC-D:3157 HC-KAR Rs.6,00,000/- by Demand Draft and Rs.1,00,000/- in cash.
The same is acknowledged in the order sheet.

Sd/-
